description:

header:
No J/Z/M service between Manhattan and Brooklyn.
Take A/C/L trains or B39 buses.
description:
Service Changes:
Jamaica-bound J/Z trains will end at Essex St, where they will turn back for Broad St-bound service.

Broad St-bound J trains will end at Marcy Av, Myrtle Av, or Broadway Junction, where they will turn back for Jamaica-bound service.

Middle Village-bound M trains will end at Essex St or 2 Av on the F, where they will turn back for Forest Hills-bound service.

Forest Hills-bound M trains will end at Marcy Av or Myrtle Av, where they will turn back for Middle Village-bound service.

Listen for crew announcements to hear how your train will run.

What's Happening?
NYPD is conducting an investigation on the Williamsburg Bridge.

Travel Alternatives:

J/M/Z Service between Brooklyn/Queens and Manhattan:

For J/Z service to/from Queens, take A/C/L trains between Manhattan and Broadway Junction.

For M service to/from Middle Village-Metropolitan Av, take L trains between 14 St / 6 Av and Myrtle-Wyckoff Avs.

Take B39 buses between Essex St and Marcy Av.

description:
